id: 24_Electrical Safety Safety measures in microbiology labs laboratory electrical saf
title: 看不见的危险：微生物实验室安全用电（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/24_Electrical Safety Safety measures in microbiology labs laboratory electrical saf.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/24_Electrical Safety Safety measures in microbiology labs laboratory electrical saf（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 用电安全，也是实验室安全
points.K3: 电线插头坏了，马上更换
points.S1: 有人触电：先断电，再施救
points.S2: 电器起火：先断电，不用水
points.S3: 维修找持证电工，不私拆
points.S4: 不私拉乱接，插线板不串接
points.S5: 设备要接地，选合格产品
points.S6: 长时间运行设备，离开前确认

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室配电箱旁，向镜头招手，配电箱上有触电警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wall electrical panel with an electric shock warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 电看不见，摸不着，却最容易伤人。
overlay: 看不见的危险：微生物实验室安全用电

shots.scene: 培养箱、水浴锅、离心机、高压灭菌器、生物安全柜排成一排，都连着电源线
shots.prompt_en: A row of lab equipment with blank panels: incubator, water bath, centrifuge, autoclave and biological safety cabinet, each with a power cord. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室，处处都在用电。

shots.scene: 阿杰把水浴锅、加热板、摇床的插头全插在一个插线板上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs a water bath, a hot plate and a shaker into one power strip on a wet bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰把三台设备插在一个插线板上。

shots.scene: 插线板的电线外皮有一处裂口，露出里面的线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the power strip cord has a cracked outer sheath. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板的电线，外皮已经裂开。

shots.scene: 插线板冒出一缕轻烟，阿杰吓了一跳
shots.prompt_en: A thin wisp of smoke rises from the power strip and the young male student steps back in surprise.
shots.narration: 突然，插线板冒出一股焦味。

shots.scene: 小研快步过来，拉下设备的电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and switches off the power at the wall switch.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧过来，先断开电源。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们来看看，用电该注意什么。

shots.section_title: 用电安全，也是实验室安全
shots.scene: 当心触电警告标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an electric shock warning sign on a lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 用电安全，是实验室安全的一部分。
overlay: 用电安全，也是实验室安全

shots.section_title: 用电安全，也是实验室安全
shots.scene: 三个图标：触电的人形、起火的插座、停转的培养箱
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a person outline with a lightning bolt, a burning wall socket, and an incubator with a stopped fan. No people.
shots.narration: 会触电、会起火，还会毁掉实验。

shots.section_title: 用电安全，也是实验室安全
shots.scene: 生物安全柜断电后风机停止，气流箭头消失
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet whose fan stops after a power cut; the airflow arrows disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜断电，防护也随之失效。

shots.scene: 小研蹲下来，查看一台设备的电源线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student crouches to inspect the power cord of a piece of equipment.
shots.narration: 用电设备要定期检查。

shots.scene: 电源线特写：外皮磨损、弯折处发白
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a power cord with worn insulation and whitened kinks. No people.
shots.narration: 看电线有没有磨破、老化。

shots.scene: 插头特写：插脚发黑、外壳开裂
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a plug with blackened pins and a cracked casing. No people.
shots.narration: 看插头有没有烧黑、松动。

shots.scene: 小研在空白检查表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks boxes on a blank inspection checklist.
shots.narration: 开机前顺手看一眼，记录在案。

shots.section_title: 电线插头坏了，马上更换
shots.scene: 破损电线被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A damaged power cord, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 电线、插头坏了，不能凑合用。
overlay: 电线插头坏了，马上更换

shots.section_title: 电线插头坏了，马上更换
shots.scene: 用胶布缠电线的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of wrapping a damaged cord with tape, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 缠胶布、接着用，都不行。

shots.section_title: 电线插头坏了，马上更换
shots.scene: 设备上挂着空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank out-of-service tag hangs on the equipment plug. No people.
shots.narration: 立即停用，挂上停用牌。

shots.section_title: 电线插头坏了，马上更换
shots.scene: 新的电源线和插头
shots.prompt_en: A new power cord and a new plug laid out side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 换上合格的新线，再恢复使用。

shots.scene: 一个插座上插满插头，插座发红
shots.prompt_en: A wall outlet crammed with plugs glows red with heat. No people.
shots.narration: 插座和插线板，都有额定功率。

shots.scene: 功率表的指针指到红区
shots.prompt_en: A simple gauge with its needle in the red zone next to a power strip. No people.
shots.narration: 插得太多，电线就会发热。

shots.scene: 火苗图标从插座冒出，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A small flame icon rising from the outlet, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 过热久了，就可能起火。

shots.scene: 高压灭菌器和培养箱各插在独立的墙插上
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave and an incubator are each plugged into their own separate wall outlets. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备，单独用一个插座。

shots.scene: 配电箱里一个带试验按钮的开关
shots.prompt_en: Inside an electrical panel, a breaker with a small test button. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器，漏电时能自动断电。

shots.scene: 电流箭头从设备外壳流向人形，开关立即跳开
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: current leaks from a device casing toward a person outline, and the breaker trips instantly. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦有人碰到漏电，它会跳闸。

shots.scene: 水池和水浴锅旁的插座
shots.prompt_en: Outlets near a sink and a water bath. No people.
shots.narration: 水池、水浴附近，尤其需要它。

shots.scene: 老李按下试验按钮，开关跳开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the test button on a breaker and it trips.
shots.narration: 按本校规定，定期试验是否有效。

shots.scene: 老李打开设备后盖做检修，旁边放着工具箱
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer services a centrifuge with its back panel open, a toolbox beside him.
shots.narration: 设备要定期维护保养。

shots.scene: 空白维护记录本和日历
shots.prompt_en: A blank maintenance logbook and a calendar with a marked date. No people.
shots.narration: 按说明书的周期，做好记录。

shots.scene: 离心机、培养箱、水浴锅旁各挂一个空白检查合格标签
shots.prompt_en: A centrifuge, an incubator and a water bath each with a blank inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 保养合格，才能继续使用。

shots.scene: 小研在维护前拔下电源插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unplugs a device before cleaning it.
shots.narration: 清洁擦拭前，先拔掉电源。

shots.scene: 王老师给学生讲解，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a small group of students in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 新设备、新人员，先培训。

shots.scene: 阿杰对照空白操作规程学习设备开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies a blank operating procedure next to a device's power switch.
shots.narration: 学会正确开机、关机和日常维护。

shots.scene: 王老师把空白准入卡交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands a blank access card to the young male student.
shots.narration: 考核通过，才能独立使用。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电，再施救
shots.scene: 人形触碰设备，身上有闪电符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person touching a device with a lightning bolt over the body. No people.
shots.narration: 有人触电，不能直接用手去拉。
overlay: 有人触电：先断电，再施救

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电，再施救
shots.scene: 小研拉下墙上的电源总开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls down the main power switch on the wall.
shots.narration: 第一步，马上切断电源。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电，再施救
shots.scene: 用干燥的木棍挑开电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of using a dry wooden stick to push a cord away from a person outline. No people.
shots.narration: 断不了电，用干燥的绝缘物挑开。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电，再施救
shots.scene: 电话图标旁写着120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 立即拨打 120，并报告老师。

shots.section_title: 有人触电：先断电，再施救
shots.scene: 急救培训课上，人体模型旁的空白证书
shots.prompt_en: A first aid training session with a manikin and a blank certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 受过训练的人，才做心肺复苏。

shots.section_title: 电器起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 插线板起火，小研拉下电闸
shots.prompt_en: A power strip catches small flames; the female graduate student switches off the wall breaker.
shots.narration: 电器起火，先断电。
overlay: 电器起火：先断电，不用水

shots.section_title: 电器起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 水桶泼向带电设备的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of throwing water on a live electrical device, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 带电设备，绝不能用水泼。

shots.section_title: 电器起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器和干粉灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide fire extinguisher and a dry powder fire extinguisher with a fire extinguisher sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用合适的灭火器，比如二氧化碳。

shots.section_title: 电器起火：先断电，不用水
shots.scene: 电话图标旁写着119
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 火势控制不住，撤离并拨打 119。

shots.section_title: 维修找持证电工，不私拆
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着螺丝刀想拆插座，被欣欣拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a screwdriver near an outlet and the panda mascot raises a paw to stop him.
shots.narration: 电路和设备坏了，学生不要自己拆修。
overlay: 维修找持证电工，不私拆

shots.section_title: 维修找持证电工，不私拆
shots.scene: 老李戴绝缘手套，在配电箱前检修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing insulated gloves, works at an open electrical panel.
shots.narration: 电工作业，要持证的专业人员来做。

shots.section_title: 维修找持证电工，不私拆
shots.scene: 阿杰拿起电话报修
shots.prompt_en: The young male student calls on the phone to report the fault.
shots.narration: 发现问题，停用并报修。

shots.section_title: 不私拉乱接，插线板不串接
shots.scene: 多个插线板首尾相连的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of several power strips daisy-chained together, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不能一个接一个串着用。
overlay: 不私拉乱接，插线板不串接

shots.section_title: 不私拉乱接，插线板不串接
shots.scene: 电线横穿过道、压在门下，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A cord stretched across a walkway and pinched under a door, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 不私拉电线，电线别横过通道。

shots.section_title: 不私拉乱接，插线板不串接
shots.scene: 插线板放在地上的水渍旁，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip lying on a wet floor, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板别放地上，远离水。

shots.section_title: 设备要接地，选合格产品
shots.scene: 三孔插头和三孔插座特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a three-pin plug and a three-hole wall outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 金属外壳的设备，要可靠接地。
overlay: 设备要接地，选合格产品

shots.section_title: 设备要接地，选合格产品
shots.scene: 掰掉接地插脚的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of breaking off the earth pin of a plug, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 三孔插头不能改成两孔用。

shots.section_title: 设备要接地，选合格产品
shots.scene: 王老师查看新设备的空白合格证
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank certificate on a newly delivered device.
shots.narration: 购买符合国家标准的合格设备。

shots.section_title: 长时间运行设备，离开前确认
shots.scene: 夜晚的实验室，培养箱指示灯亮着
shots.prompt_en: A dark lab at night with an incubator's indicator light glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 培养箱等要长时间运行的设备，
overlay: 长时间运行设备，离开前确认

shots.section_title: 长时间运行设备，离开前确认
shots.scene: 设备上挂着空白的运行标识牌
shots.prompt_en: A blank running-status tag hangs on the incubator. No people.
shots.narration: 要经同意，挂牌注明负责人。

shots.section_title: 长时间运行设备，离开前确认
shots.scene: 小研下班前关掉水浴锅和加热板
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, the female graduate student switches off the water bath and the hot plate.
shots.narration: 其他设备，离开前要关闭断电。

shots.section_title: 长时间运行设备，离开前确认
shots.scene: 无人看管的加热板图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unattended hot plate, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 加热设备，不能无人看管。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，白板上依次亮起检查、使用、维护、培训四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where four icons light up: magnifier, plug, wrench, teacher.
shots.narration: 勤检查，不过载，按时维护，先培训。

shots.scene: 断电开关和打叉的水桶
shots.prompt_en: A power switch being turned off, beside a crossed-out water bucket. No people.
shots.narration: 触电起火，第一步都是断电。

shots.scene: 阿杰把三台设备分别插在独立插座上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs the three devices into separate wall outlets and throws away the damaged power strip.
shots.narration: 阿杰换掉了那个破插线板。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰一起在空白检查表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student sign a blank inspection checklist together.
shots.narration: 维修交给电工，离开记得断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，向镜头挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 安全用电，从每一个插头做起，再见！
